paragraphs: R. Yaakov Korshai; another version: ben Korshai. He is mentioned in Horayot (13b), where R. Meir said to R. Natan (see his entry): 'Let us say to Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel: Begin teaching Uktzin, which he does not know.' R. Yaakov ben Korshai heard, went, sat opposite Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel's window, and studied and recited Uktzin. Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel paid attention and studied Uktzin. In Vayikra Rabbah, section 3: bar Korshai. He is Rabbi's teacher (see his entry), in the Jerusalem Talmud at the beginning of the chapter Arvei Pesaḥim and at the end of the chapter HaMatznia.
